note: Public-domain Hawaiian / hapa-haole tunes Embry hums (she loves the old kitschy Hawaiian sound). ALL picks are compositions published 1930 or earlier -> US public domain as of 2026 (Duke CSPD, verified). The beloved 1930s film-era hits (Sweet Leilani 1937, My Little Grass Shack 1933, Blue Hawaii 1937) are NOT yet PD and are excluded until their year. Hum the ORIGINAL melody only, never a modern copyrighted arrangement (esp. Hawaiian War Chant: 1860s Leleiohoku melody is PD; the 1936 Johnny Noble arrangement is not). Recognizability caveat: ElevenLabs SFX humming is non-lexical and note-approximate, so a clip evokes the STYLE/mood, not a note-accurate rendition (which also keeps it doubly clear of the melody copyright). Clips stored on the 12TB drive; persona_memory holds the taste facts + metadata for semantic (text_mm) recall by mood/tempo/category. Delay composition: one hum clip is ~20-22s (ElevenLabs SFX per-call cap 22s); it is ONE delay ingredient — combine it with [pause:*] pause macros and thinking-sound macros (mm/hmm) to cover longer waits rather than forcing a single long render.

render_rule: NEVER vintage-sounding. The tune may be old/public-domain, but every hum RENDER must be a clean, present, modern close-microphone recording of Embry humming — never phonograph/period/lo-fi texture. Prompts must NOT contain era cues (1910s/1920s/old-timey/novelty/craze/vintage); those make the SFX model produce a lo-fi phone-like recording (human-caught on ukulele-lady). Say 'clear, present, modern, close-mic' instead. Render at 44.1k stereo. HUMS MUST BE BONE DRY — no reverb, no room ambience, intimate close-mic (human rule 2026-09-12); use prompt_influence<=0.25 and a 'bone dry, no reverb' prompt. Piano/orchestral-only pieces that have no vocal hum line (e.g. Moonlight Sonata, Mahler Adagietto) are NOT hums and are removed. SFX-generated hums are a neutral voice, NOT Embry's clone — 'sounds like Embry' needs her v3 clone humming (open limitation). All hums are post-processed as steady under-speech beds: acompressor=threshold=-20dB:ratio=3:attack=20:release=250 (tame internal dynamics) -> loudnorm=I=-20:TP=-1.5:LRA=7 (consistent loudness + -1.5 dBTP true-peak limit). No hum plays louder or peaks higher than the others; filler_gain.py then fits each -1.5..-5 dB under measured speech RMS (human rule 2026-09-12).
